speaker: The serpent
text: Did God really say, ‘You must not eat from any tree in the garden?’

text: We may eat the fruit of the trees of the garden, but about the fruit of the tree in the middle of the garden, God has said, ‘You must not eat of it or touch it, or you will die.’

speaker: The serpent
text: You will not surely die, | For God knows that in the day you eat of it, your eyes will be opened and you will be like God, knowing good and evil.
You remember the letter in Grandma's trunk: you cannot change what happened.

When the woman saw that the tree was good for food and pleasing to the eyes, and that it was desirable for obtaining wisdom, she took the fruit and ate it. She also gave some to her husband who was with her, and he ate it.
The serpent made God's good command sound like a trick. Sin often starts by doubting that God's word is good.
And the eyes of both of them were opened, and they knew that they were naked; so they sewed together fig leaves and made coverings for themselves.
Then the man and his wife heard the voice of the LORD God walking in the garden in the breeze of the day, and they hid themselves from the presence of the LORD God among the trees of the garden.

speaker: The LORD God
text: Where are you?

speaker: The man
text: I heard Your voice in the garden, | and I was afraid because I was naked; so I hid myself.

speaker: The LORD God
text: Who told you that you were naked? | Have you eaten from the tree of which I commanded you not to eat?

speaker: The man
text: The woman whom You gave me, she gave me fruit from the tree, and I ate it.

speaker: The LORD God
text: What is this you have done?

speaker: The woman
text: The serpent deceived me, | and I ate.

speaker: The LORD God
text: And I will put enmity between you and the woman, and between your seed and her seed. He will crush your head, and you will strike his heel.
Even in this sad moment, God made a promise: one day a child of the woman would crush the serpent's head.
Long after, the Bible calls that ancient serpent the devil (Revelation 12:9). And it says this about Jesus, the Son of God:
… This is why the Son of God was revealed, to destroy the works of the devil.

text: … For dust you are, and to dust you shall return.
